::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 20th 1875  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge VIII 4
:::

My dear [Mrs Warburton](people/person_1465.qmd)

A great many thanks for your kind [present](other_books/otherbook_860.qmd).[^1] It is my favourite period of history and I am sure [Mr Warburton](people/person_1466.qmd)will have treated it in a more kindred spirit than I think has been shewn in all the books of this series, some of which have disappointed me especially the Wars of the Roses, but I am sure I shall enjoy reading this.

Yours very sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: William Parsons Warburton, *Edward III* (1874). CMY was still recommending it in 1881: see Coleridge, *Life*, 56.  It appeared in the 'Epochs of Modern History' series.
